title: Score hit its literal maximum, 366/366, at turn ~476 of a 574-turn win — while I was still mid-Act-2 with whole regions (the Saltkerns), several companion side-quests, and two Wardmoor quests untouched. The score header claims 'it can fill long before the tale ends,' but hitting the hard cap (not just approaching it) undercuts score as any kind of completion signal.
where: status command, right after 'speak the three verses over the court' at The Kings' Rest, Hollowbrook
